newsitem.title: USA: General Scanning denies breach of contract.
newsitem.headline: General Scanning denies breach of contract.

text.p: General Scanning Inc on Friday denied any suggestion it had failed to fully deliver on its obligations under a contract with Voxel Corp.
The contract was for General Scanning to develop a system to produce holographic, three dimensional images onto film from CAT scan or magnetic resonance imaging data sets, the company said.

On December 24, Voxel alleged General Scanning, which makes the Voxcam imager, had breached the contract. It said General Scanning failed to meet engineering specifications, product performance requirements and scheduled delivery dates, Voxel said. Voxel said it was seeking redress.
But General Scanning said it had successfully completed design, produced an alpha unit as proof of concept and manufactured a beta unit accepted by Voxel.
It said it was also completing and delivering additional beta test units.
In the interim, General Scanning said it expected Voxel to honor all its contractual obligations to General Scanning, including General Scanning's exclusive production rights.
